translations.web: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
translations.bsb: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”
translations.kjv: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
translations.asv: I would haste me to a shelter From the stormy wind and tempest.
